data.one_liner: Play YouTube videos inline using the official IFrame Player API in a minimal native WebView.
data.what_it_does: embeds YouTube videos across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and web platforms. It uses synchronous native interop (JNI, FFI, js_interop) instead of platform channels, providing instant command execution and state getters. It also supports custom Flutter control overlays and native fullscreen.
use_when: You need to play YouTube videos within your Flutter application across multiple platforms.
You want synchronous API calls for player controls and getters without dealing with Futures.
You need to customize player controls using your own Flutter widgets.
avoid_when: You need to play raw video files or streaming URLs instead of YouTube content.
You are targeting platforms where you require custom webview fallback behavior beyond what the plugin offers.
strengths: Synchronous APIs powered by native interop (no platform channel overhead).
Supports custom Flutter UI overlays via controlsBuilder.
Native system fullscreen handling without Flutter-side reparenting.
weaknesses: Hiding certain native elements relies on undocumented CSS selectors which may break if YouTube updates its player.
Link navigation hooks are ignored on the web due to cross-origin iframe limitations.
data.setup_notes: Android declares INTERNET automatically (optional Hybrid Composition++ meta-data available). macOS requires the com.apple.security.network.client entitlement.
